scripts.package:win: pnpm build:llama && pnpm build:backend && turbo run build && pnpm --filter @aios/desktop package
scripts.check:py: uv lock --check && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run lint-imports && uv run mypy packages/py/aios-common/src services/backend/aios_backend services/backend/db services/evidence-writer/aios_evidence_writer && uv run aios-backend openapi --check && uv run python tools/contracts/gen_process_ipc_vectors.py --check && uv run python tools/contracts/gen_evidence_vectors.py --check && uv run python tools/contracts/gen_project_packages.py --check && uv run python tools/contracts/gen_recovery_reference.py --check && uv run python tools/run_tests.py

scripts.build:backend: uv run pyinstaller build/pyinstaller/backend.spec --distpath build/out --workpath build/out/work --noconfirm && uv run pyinstaller build/pyinstaller/evidence-writer.spec --distpath build/out --workpath build/out/work-writer --noconfirm
